pages.title: Bacterial growth curve four phases

concepts.label: Log / exponential phase rapid division and drug susceptibility
concepts.detail: Rapid cell division occurs; high metabolic rate which is the potential drug acting phase.

concepts.label: Stationary phase nutrient depletion
concepts.detail: Occurs when nutrient depletion or toxic products cause growth to slow.

concepts.label: Death / decline phase
concepts.detail: Marked by a decline in the number of viable bacteria.
